verdict_raw:
**Verdict: Good overall, but a few real issues — not CLEAN.**

## 1. Overlapping / clipped UI
- **Right edge of the top toolbar:** the "Label" item (T icon + text) runs flush against the viewport edge at x≈1280 with zero padding — it appears clipped or one resize away from clipping. The toolbar group (Season / Growth / Permits / Templates / Label) needs right padding, or the overflow items should collapse into a "More" menu.
- **Modal vs. floating panel:** the settings panel behind the modal (Measure / Atmosphere…) is only peeking out as a ~20px sliver of truncated letter fragments on the modal's left edge. Because the modal has **no dimmed backdrop**, it reads less like "dialog over content" and more like two UI layers colliding. Adding a scrim (e.g., 40% black) would fix both the look and the focus.
- **Minor:** in the compass widget, the red needle tip sits right on top of the "S" label — slight visual crowding.

## 2. 5-second comprehension
- **Mostly yes.** "Social Sharing Card" title + subtitle + an obvious green "Download PNG" is immediately clear, and the preview card (title, size, object count, branding) is well composed.
- The missing backdrop is the main comprehension drag: the full-width toolbar, floating buttons, badge stack, and side panels are all at full brightness behind the modal, so a new user's eye has nowhere to land.
- The **"Grid at Y=4 ft"** banner is developer jargon pinned top-center with no context — a new user won't know why it's there or what it does.

## 3. Confusing / ambiguous / broken-looking
- **"FPS: 2"** in the status bar is a red flag — either the app is genuinely lagging or it's debug info exposed to end users. Either way it undermines the polish; hide it or investigate.
- **Redundant controls:** "Tape Measure" in the bottom toolbar vs. "Measure" in the floating panel, plus a separate scale bar and "Sun" button scattered nearby. The bottom zone has 3–4 competing控件 clusters (toolbar, scale+Sun, panel) that feel unorganized.
- The small **green circular button** in the bottom-right of the preview card is ambiguous — unclear if it's share, download, or refresh.
- Minor: "Patios & Paths" is the last visible sidebar item, cut exactly at the status bar — acceptable if scrollable, but consider a fade-out hint.

**Suggested fixes:** add a modal scrim, pad/overflow-handle the toolbar, contextualize or demote the "Grid at Y=4 ft" banner, and hide or fix the FPS readout. Everything else — sidebar taxonomy, modal composition, centered dialog, footer status bar — is solid.
